en.headline: Woman found unconscious after unit fire in Tin Shui Wai estate
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at Kingswood Villas Locwood Court Block 14 after a 5:39pm report; a woman was found unconscious in a stairwell and taken to hospital, with about 100 people evacuated.
body: Police received multiple reports at about 5:39pm on Saturday of thick smoke coming from a mid-level unit in Block 14 of Locwood Court at Kingswood Villas in Tin Shui Wai. Firefighters deployed a smoke-diving team and hoses, bringing the fire under control by about 6:07pm.

During the search, rescuers found a woman unconscious in a stairwell and sent her to Tin Shui Wai Hospital for treatment. Police said the preliminary investigation suggested the fire started from clutter in the unit. About 100 people evacuated on their own.
The cause of the fire and the reason for the woman’s unconsciousness remain under investigation, according to police.

zh.headline: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居單位起火 女子昏迷送院
zh.dek: 警方下午約5時39分接報嘉湖山莊樂湖居14座單位冒煙，消防約6時07分將火救熄；搜救期間發現一名女子在梯間昏迷，送天水圍醫院治理，約100人自行疏散。
body: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居14座星期六下午發生火警。警方約下午5時39分接獲多名居民報案，指一中層單位冒出濃煙。消防出動煙帽隊及拖喉灌救，約晚上6時07分將火救熄。
搜救期間，救援人員在梯間發現一名女子昏迷，將她送往天水圍醫院治理。警方表示，初步調查懷疑火警原因是單位內雜物起火，事件中約100人自行疏散。
火警起因及女子昏迷原因仍在調查中。
